results.title: Two Marseille drug traffickers sentenced to life in prison over triple murder
results.content: Two figures in Marseille’s drug trafficking ring were sentenced to life in prison on Monday over a triple murder committed in 2020. Among the victims was Brahim Chabane, the older brother of anti-drug activist and deputy mayor of Marseille Amine Kessaci.

results.title: 'Weirdo specialist' is the new Bond: Papers react to Robert Pattinson as 007
results.content: PRESS REVIEW – Tuesday, November 17: European papers react to five EU countries' plan for a migrant expulsion centre in Rwanda. In other news, the Guardian reveals Israel's use of Amazon's cloud system for facial recognition in Gaza. Plus: the wait for the new James Bond is finally over.

results.title: French presidential debate: 'Le Pen exposed xenophobic and authoritarian aspects of her policies'
results.content: Eve Irvine is pleased to welcome Damien Lecomte, French political scientist, researcher, and lecturer at the University of Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne. With five months to go before France's presidential election, Marine Le Pen leads the opinion polls, while Jean-Luc Mélenchon emerges as her most likely second-round opponent. Lecomte says that "the other candidates are basically fighting for the second spot" and that the center and right are "desperately trying to find a way to avoid a second round" between the two. He also warns that a Le Pen presidency could "really change the political life with more xenophobic and nationalistic policies,"even if her ability to secure a parliamentary majority remains uncertain.

results.title: COP31: Corporate interests gain access to govt delegations participating in climate negotiations
results.content: Eve Irvine is pleased to welcome Siphesihle Mvundla, South African Climate and Energy Justice Campaigner at groundWork, a non-profit environmental justice organization. At COP31 in Turkey, representatives of major polluting industries have gained access to climate negotiations through government delegations, accredited organisations and other participation arrangements, according to research by the Kick Big Polluters Out coalition. Mvundla questions the extent of their involvement: "This year particularly, it's not just about the numbers, but it's about the influence that these private interests would have on the negotiations." UEFA backs bid by France's Diallo to take on Infantino as FIFA chief
results.content: UEFA has backed a bid by French Football Federation (FFF) President Philippe Diallo ⁠to run for ​the FIFA presidency in next March's election after Diallo emerged as an unexpected opponent to the current head of football's world governing body Gianni Infantino

results.title: Third US aircraft carrier arrives in the Middle East as Iran targets Bahrain
results.content: A third American aircraft carrier has arrived in the Middle East, US Central Command said in a social media post Monday, making a dramatic show of military might as President Donald Trump keeps his options open for next steps in the Iran war. It comes as Tehran said Sunday that its forces carried out a drone attack on a US radar system at a helicopter base in the Gulf kingdom of Bahrain.

results.title: Saudi Arabia replaces military commander after Yemen setbacks
results.content: Saudi Arabia replaced the commander overseeing its coalition against Yemen's Iran-allied Houthis on Monday after Riyadh's Yemeni allies were forced to withdraw from swathes of territory in a major setback for their campaign against the group.

results.title: 5 European countries aim to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda
results.content: A group of European countries announced Monday that they aim to set up a “return hub” in Rwanda where rejected asylum seekers could be sent from next year, a move that they hope will also deter more people from coming. The plan by Austria, Denmark, Germany, Greece and the Netherlands, which have spearheaded negotiations with non-EU countries, drew immediate criticism from human rights groups.

results.title: Trump arrives in Philippines to kick off Asia trip
results.content: US President Donald Trump arrived in the Philippines on Tuesday at the tail end of a Southeast Asian summit, with protests awaiting him as he prepares for the first meeting in two years of the Quad group of Indo-Pacific countries. France 24’s correspondent Tommy Walker has the details.

results.title: Candidates clash over cost of living in French presidential debate
results.content: Five of the frontrunners for the French presidential election lined up for the second of this year's debates on Monday night. In an often-rowdy debate, candidates clashed over counterproposals to raise and cut taxes and slash public spending.

results.title: France's far-right presidential candidate Le Pen to set out pension plans
results.content: France's far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen is to set out pension proposals on Tuesday as she seeks to convince investors she can balance one of her most popular electoral pledges ‌with promises to restore order to the public finances. Le Pen’s National Rally (RN) has pledged to allow people ⁠who started work young to retire as early as 60, although it is under pressure to detail how it would ‌do this while also curbing budget deficits.

results.title: Russia receiving ‘dozens of missiles per month’ from North Korea, says Kyiv
results.content: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky said Monday that Russia was receiving "dozens of missiles per month" from North Korea and warned that the country was taking advantage of the war to make its weapons "more effective". He called on European allies to send more weapons so that Ukraine can respond "on equal terms" to the threat.

results.title: China, Canada agree to further reduce tariffs at APEC summit in Shenzhen
results.content: China is hosting the 21-member Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen this week, hoping to use the tech megalopolis to showcase its vision for international trade and development. The summit is also where the international agenda is enacted: Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney has met with his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping, with both leaders agreeing to reduce trade barriers between their countries. Also in this edition: Nvidia reportedly rejects a return of its former CEO Jensen Huang.

results.title: Data leak exposes Deutsche Bank ties to Russian oligarchs, Epstein and Trump
results.content: Shares in Deutsche Bank plunged Tuesday after international media outlets published reports detailing the bank's questionable business practices over the past 20 years, including its ties to Russian oligarchs, convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein and Donald Trump before he became the US president.

results.title: AFCON 2027 qualifiers: Senegal beat Sudan and close in on qualification
results.content: Senegal beat Sudan 4–2 on Matchday 4 of the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers. Senegal top Group J and could secure qualification as early as Tuesday, November 17.

results.title: Live: France braces for new day of protests as unions call for nationwide strike
results.content: France braced for another day of protests Tuesday as unions called for a nationwide strike by public sector workers in a bid to secure pay rises. Youth organisations and Yellow Vest activists are also set to join the demonstrations. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

results.title: New mass protests expected in France Tuesday as presidential election approaches
results.content: Unions in France are calling for a strike Tuesday to demand wage increases, with students also expected to join. With under five months to go before the presidential election, FRANCE 24's Monte Francis asks Ariane Bogain, Senior Lecturer in French Politics at Northumbria University, what role the widespread discontent will play in the upcoming vote.

results.title: France and Malaysia upgrade ties and announce rare earths, defence cooperation deals
results.content: French President Emmanuel Macron and Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim agreed cooperation deals on rare earths, energy and defence in Kuala Lumpur on Tuesday. Macron's two-day visit, during which France and Malaysia gave their ties strategic partnership status, comes ahead of the 70th anniversary of the countries' diplomatic relations.

results.title: Trump kicks off Asia trip that will see nuclear talks with Xi, Putin
results.content: US President Donald Trump on Monday landed in the Philippines for the first leg of his Asia trip which will see economic talks and a planned trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin later this week. Trump also raised the possibility of meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during his visit.

results.title: France Cricket federation faces collapse after funding scandal exposed by FRANCE 24
results.content: France's national cricket organisation is on the verge of collapse, a top administrator says, three years after an explosive FRANCE 24 investigation revealed accusations that the body was faking matches to claim funds from the International Cricket Council.

results.title: Live: Bridge to occupied Crimea closed after Ukrainian strikes collapse road section
results.content: The Ukrainian military said on Tuesday that the Crimea Bridge was closed to road traffic after its drone and missile strikes caused a section of road to collapse, blocking access to the Russian-occupied territory. Russian strikes in Kyiv also hit two bridges overnight from Monday, causing closures and knocking out heating and water. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

results.title: Russian strikes hit two key bridges in Kyiv, disrupting water and power supplies
results.content: Russian forces struck two major bridges crossing the Dnipro River in Kyiv late Monday, damaging critical infrastructure and causing water and power cuts in parts of the Ukrainian capital, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said. The attacks came as Moscow launched a wider wave of drone and missile strikes across Ukraine, including in the regions of Cherkasy and Kharkiv.

results.title: Ukraine hits key Crimea bridge with drones
results.content: "I think the Ukrainians are trying to send a message to the Russians with this - 'If you hit our bridges we can hit yours,'" reports Gulliver Cragg from Kyiv.
